name: codebara-monorepo
description: Codebara desktop overlay companion with CLI and VS Code support.
author: SkyesMind

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @codebara/shared build && pnpm --filter @codebara/overlay build && pnpm --filter codebara build && pnpm --filter codebara-vscode-extension build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @codebara/shared lint && pnpm --filter @codebara/overlay lint && pnpm --filter codebara lint && pnpm --filter codebara-vscode-extension lint
